HBR_NATIVE_MR_STRUGGLES.description: At the start of your turn, deal damage to ALL enemies equal to {HbrEffectSkillPower}% skill power times the turn number.
HBRGO_THIRTY_ONE_D_SCOUTING.title: 31D 侦察
HBRGO_THIRTY_ONE_D_SCOUTING.description: 带有31D小徽章的节点已经侦察。图标表示实际房间类型；悬停可查看事件、记忆碎片的回忆与人物，或宝箱为每名玩家保留的遗物。只显示房间类型，不预告战斗中的敌人。
HBRGO_RISA_DP.title: DP 回复
HBRGO_RISA_DP.description: DP先于生命承受伤害。本张牌按每名目标自己的最大DP回复，单独处理玩家与幻影的DP池，不把玩家的回复转移给其幻影。治愈微笑及真心款待可将当前DP补至上限的120%，不提高DP上限。
HBR_CLASS_RELIC_MODE_SWITCH.title: Change Form
HBR_CLASS_RELIC_MODE_SWITCH.description: Triggers when entering Bow, Dual Swords or Scythe form. Opening or closing Magic Sword does not count.
HBR_CLASS_RELIC_SIX_SENSE_POINTS.title: Six Sense Points
HBR_CLASS_RELIC_SIX_SENSE_POINTS.descrip: Allocate these points in the Electronic Soldier Manual to raise the corresponding Six Sense.
HBR_CLASS_RELIC_CRITICAL_SUCCESS.title: Critical Success
HBR_CLASS_RELIC_CRITICAL_SUCCESS.descrip: Triggers whenever a roll resolves as a Critical Success, including absolute, guaranteed and treated-as successes.
HBR_CLASS_RELIC_FORM_CARD.title: Form Card
HBR_CLASS_RELIC_FORM_CARD.description: A card marked as a Bow Form card or a Dual Swords Form card.
